title: Valid pair encoding
statement: A Boolean list $y$ is a valid pair encoding if there are a natural number $n$ and Boolean lists $u,w$ such that $y$ is the pair encoding of the list of $n$ copies of true with the pair encoding of $u$ and $w$, and both $u$ and $w$ are canonical.
